name: weather
title: Weather
description: Local weather from Open-Meteo, with no account or key: a live sky with the next hours and the week ahead, and a bar item that stays out of the way in ordinary weather and shows up for rain, fog, wind or uncomfortable temperatures.
author: pal

settings.label: Location
settings.description: A place name, optionally narrowed by region or country: “Istanbul”, “London, Ontario”, “Paris, Texas”. Only the first part is searched; the rest choose between same-named places. Resolved privately by Open-Meteo's location search. The palette's L key searches and sets it too.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: The weather where you are over a live sky: the reading now with its picture, what is coming over the next hours, and the days ahead with each one's span.

temp.description: The temperature now, in the service's unit

quiet.description: A clear or cloudy sky (WMO 0 to 3): nothing falling, no fog

rain_in.description: Hours until rain is likely (a wet hour, or a chance of half or more) within the next day; 0 while it rains, unknown when none comes

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: A quiet condition-led weather signal: hidden by its rules in ordinary weather (a quiet sky between 10 and 30 degrees), visible for rain now or likely within 12 hours, fog, wind or temperatures outside that band, blue when cold and red when hot. The popover is the forecast: the reading now on a card tinted by the sky, humidity, wind, UV and the next sunrise or sunset, the next eight hours, then five days with each day's span against theirs.

item.title: 14°C
item.tooltip: Overcast in Istanbul · rain likely around 06:00

rules.when: weather.quiet and weather.temp >= 10 and weather.temp <= 30 and not (weather.rain_in <= 12)
rules.description: A quiet sky inside the comfort band with no rain likely in the next 12 hours: off the strip (move the band or the window here).
Rain likely within 12 hours while the sky is still dry: the rain glyph, in blue.

store.tagline: A live sky with the weather where you are, and a bar item only when it is worth noticing
features: The reading now with its own picture, over a sky drawn live from the forecast: clouds by cover drifting with the wind, sunset colours, stars, rain, snow, fog and lightning
One plain sentence on what is coming, then the next hours with sunrise and sunset in their place
The days ahead with each one's span against the others, today's reading marked on it
Pick a day and its hours fill the row; walk the hours and the sky turns to each one
Opens at once on the last reading and refreshes behind it; search for a place right in the palette
The bar item hides in ordinary weather and comes back for rain now or within 12 hours, fog, wind, heat or cold
